name: New 1-2 star App Store reviews to Slack (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Send new 1-2 star App Store reviews to Slack with Apify

**Who it's for:** Mobile product, support and community teams who want to see every new negative review the moment it lands.

**How it works**
1. The schedule runs the App Store Reviews Scraper Actor on Apify for your app with a 1-2 star filter and **Only new reviews** on.
2. Each run returns only reviews posted since the last run, with rating, title, text, app version and country.
3. A Code node turns each review into a Slack message.
4. Nothing is sent when there are no new bad reviews.

*Built on Apify Actors by AutomationNation. You need an Apify account; runs bill per result on it.*

## Bad app reviews to Slack
1. Create a free Apify account and copy your API token.
2. Add a **Header Auth** credential: `Authorization` = `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
3. Put your App Store app URL or ID in **Get new low-star reviews** (for Google Play, swap the Actor to google-play-reviews-scraper).
4. Connect Slack. Only reviews posted since the last run are sent.

Cost: $0.08 per 1,000 reviews.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs every morning at 8:00. Change the time or interval here.

nodes.name: Get new low-star reviews

httpHeaderAuth.name: Apify API token (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <token>)

nodes.notes: Calls the Apify Actor through run-sync-get-dataset-items and waits for the rows. With onlyNewReviews and a 1-2 star filter it returns only new negative reviews. Uses a Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <Apify token>), never a hard-coded key.

nodes.name: Format message
nodes.notes: One Slack message per review: stars, app, country, version, title and text.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts the message to the Slack channel you pick. Change the channel name or swap this node for email, Discord or Telegram.
